ItemID: NA; Title: Aenima Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: After 10.000 Days, I would choose another Tool album for its intricate rhythms and heavy atmosphere.
ItemID: NA; Title: Reign In Blood Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: My heavier listening makes this appealing; I would choose it for its speed and intensity.
ItemID: NA; Title: St. Anger Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its raw, repetitive approach is less appealing right now than the layered heavy music I have been exploring.
ItemID: NA; Title: Lateralus; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I would choose this immediately to explore more of Tool's expansive songs after 10.000 Days.
ItemID: NA; Title: Hybrid Theory; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its melodic hooks and heavy guitars fit parts of my history, but I would prioritize Tool this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Pearl Jam; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Straightforward alternative rock is less aligned with my current interest in heavier, more intricate music.
ItemID: NA; Title: Follow The Leader Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The heavy grooves appeal alongside my recent Disturbed listening, but it is not a first choice today.
ItemID: NA; Title: With Teeth Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try its tense industrial sound as a change of texture while keeping the intensity I enjoy.
ItemID: NA; Title: Adore; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its subdued electronic atmosphere does not match the guitar-heavy listening I want right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Godsmack Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its muscular riffs fit my hard-rock interests, but the Tool albums are more compelling choices this time.
